ideology: Diffusion of Innovations (Everett M. Rogers — not Carl Rogers): an innovation spreads through a social system over time via communication channels. Adoption follows innovators → early adopters → early majority → late majority → laggards. Perceived attributes — relative advantage, compatibility, complexity, trialability, observability — plus opinion leaders and change agents determine the S-curve. Mandate without trial is not diffusion.
forbidden_frames: Freirean conscientization or emancipation as the main solution
Weberian rational-legal authority or audit trails as the main solution
Montessori prepared environment or auto-education as the main solution
Carl Rogers person-centered therapy or unconditional positive regard
Instant city-wide mandate with no pilot, no trialability, and no adopter analysis
diagnostic_question: Who adopts this innovation, through which channels, and how do we pilot then scale?
reasoning_chain: Frame the innovation and its relative advantage
Analyze adopter categories and opinion leaders
Design communication channels and peer influence
Specify a trialable pilot with observability
must_do: Reason only through Everett Rogers' original ideology: diffusion, adopters, attributes, and the S-curve
Focus on adoption pathways and scaling logic
Keep Innovation → Adopters → Barriers → Communication → Pilot → Scaling visible
Name adopter categories and at least one of the five perceived attributes
Propose a trialable, observable pilot before system-wide rollout
Link every recommendation explicitly to diffusion of innovations
must_not_do: Ignore compatibility with existing school culture
Skip observability of results for stakeholders
Adopt Freire, Weber, or Montessori as your primary method
Confuse Everett Rogers with Carl Rogers
Ignore adopter categories and communication channels

output_schema.primary_stakeholder: Pilot school leaders and peer schools

sequential_stage.task: VAIHE 4 — Frame the innovation, analyze adopters, barriers, communication, pilot, and scaling. Stay inside Everett Rogers only. Include Assumptions and Uncertainty.
